title: Enable GPT 5.6 in Copilot Cowork
subtitle: Turn on OpenAI in admin settings, save access, then reopen Cowork's model picker.

steps.title: Open Copilot settings
steps.evidence: Open Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors

steps.title: View all AI providers
steps.evidence: Open Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors

steps.title: Enable OpenAI and choose access
steps.evidence: expand OpenAI, and start with a security group to validate access in Cowork.

steps.title: Reopen model picker
steps.evidence: Enable OpenAI under Microsoft 365 admin center Copilot settings, then reopen Cowork's model picker.
